The top flap of the casing has engraved text that appears to read 'ENGLAND' and other specifications, though the characters are distorted and mirrored. A black rubber eyepiece ring is visible on the left side. The background is a soft, out-of-focus blue-grey.

The reflections on the metal are overly smooth and plastic-like, lacking the micro-scratches and fine imperfections typical of real-world polished metal tools.
